name: Dimely
long_description:
Dimely helps accounting teams scale their order management & contract review workflows. Today fast-growing tech unicorns like Checkr and Airbyte get more coverage with less manual work by using Dimely’s AI agents to intelligently extract relevant details from core files like Order Forms, MSAs & POs, flag discrepancies, and then sync this information to core finance systems like NetSuite and Stripe.

Dimely leverages what finance and accounting teams love most, spreadsheets, for all its workflows so teams never feel out of place. Teams just replace their existing, siloed Excel spreadsheet with one that's connected and powered by AI. Teams love Dimely for its ease of use and intuitive user experience that saves them hundreds if not thousands of hours a month.

launches.title: 🔎 SheetWhiz: The Best Way to Audit Your Google Spreadsheets
launches.tagline: The most powerful Trace Precedents tool for Google Sheets. As AI generates more formulas, SheetWhiz helps you trace, verify, and catch mistakes before they lead to bad decisions.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103832&key=user_uploads/993872/5a9b468b-3cb9-4b3f-a355-6d7c3b5a9659)

## TL;DR

AI is going to generate more of your spreadsheet analysis.

That is powerful, but it creates a new problem: if AI writes the analysis, who catches the mistakes?

SheetWhiz helps you audit the logic behind your spreadsheet work before you rely on it. You can trace where numbers come from, understand how formulas flow through your model, verify that calculations make sense, and catch mistakes before they lead to bad decisions.

Under the hood, SheetWhiz gives you the most powerful Trace Precedents and Trace Dependents workflow in Google Sheets, with multi-level formula tracing, step-by-step formula evaluation, and AI built into the audit flow.

SheetWhiz is already used by over 10,000 professionals at some of the most productive companies in the world, including Anthropic, DoorDash, Robinhood, Chime, and GitLab.

Try SheetWhiz free from the Chrome Web Store.

## The Problem

AI is making it easier than ever to create spreadsheet analysis.

It can write formulas, build models, summarize data, and automate workflows that used to take hours. That is a huge productivity unlock, especially for teams that live in spreadsheets.

But it also creates a new risk: people will start shipping analysis they do not fully understand.

And even the best AI-generated spreadsheet work still needs review.

Wall Street Prep recently tested leading AI tools for financial modeling against investment banking standards. Even the winning tool scored only **5.7 / 10** on accuracy of data extraction, formatting, and modeling best practices, and **5.0 / 10** on quality and rigor of forecasting and model structure.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103832&key=user_uploads/993872/d615388a-d070-4bbe-8a3b-82dede469baf)

_Source: [https://www.wallstreetprep.com/knowledge/ranking-the-best-ai-tools-for-financial-modeling-2026](https://www.wallstreetprep.com/knowledge/ranking-the-best-ai-tools-for-financial-modeling-2026/)_

That does not mean AI is not useful. It means AI can help generate the first draft, but humans still need to inspect the logic before relying on the output.

The dangerous part is that the final output can look credible.

When AI generates a formula, the formula may look sophisticated. The model may look complete. The analysis may look ready to send. But unless someone can inspect the logic, trace the inputs, and explain how the number was calculated, the work is not truly understood.

Don’t be the person who puts your name on analysis you cannot defend.

Not when the numbers matter.

## The Most Powerful Trace Precedents Workflow for Google Sheets

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=10-XhrwDmo4>

SheetWhiz is built around the spreadsheet audit workflow people actually need: select a formula, understand where it came from, inspect the logic, fix issues, and keep working.

With Trace Precedents, you can select any formula and instantly see every cell feeding into it. You can jump directly to each source cell, move through references with your keyboard, and expand the precedents of those precedent cells to trace the formula multiple levels deep.

Instead of manually hunting through tabs and cell references, SheetWhiz gives you an interactive audit trail for your spreadsheet.

You can see where a number came from, what it depends on, and how it flows through the model.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103832&key=user_uploads/993872/13edeec1-e48b-4fcd-9d50-89a2fda13ec0)

But tracing cells is only the first step. The harder part is understanding what the formula is actually doing.

That is why SheetWhiz also has the Evaluates Formulas and Groups toggle.

If you are looking at a VLOOKUP, SheetWhiz can show the lookup value, the table being searched, the return column, and the exact value the function returns. Instead of manually counting columns and checking ranges, you can see the result of the lookup immediately.

If you are looking at INDEX/MATCH, SheetWhiz can break apart what MATCH is finding and what INDEX is returning. You can see which row or column was matched, which source cell was returned, and how the final result was calculated.

This matters because AI-generated formulas often look correct at a glance. They can use advanced functions, nested logic, and ranges that appear reasonable. But the only way to trust the output is to inspect what each part is doing.

SheetWhiz makes that inspection fast.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103832&key=user_uploads/993872/bc42a520-8757-4429-9d96-4d528a22c9fa)

## AI Built Into the Audit Workflow

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103832&key=user_uploads/993872/4d36128a-3af3-4ab4-a05b-75ee1a7ae8e7)

We layered AI directly into tracing.

That does not just mean generic formula explanations. SheetWhiz has the context of your spreadsheet, the selected cell, the referenced cells, the formula being evaluated, and the surrounding model or analysis. If you’re building an LBO, SheetWhiz AI knows you’re building an LBO and will let you know whether your returns analysis is calculating correctly based on that model.

In a data analysis, SheetWhiz can explain the mechanics of the formula. If you are not familiar with VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, LET, or another function, you can ask what the formula is doing, how it works, and whether anything looks off.

That is the workflow we think people need as AI writes more spreadsheet work:

Generate the work, then inspect it, understand it, and verify it before you rely on it.

## Other Auditing Tools

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103832&key=user_uploads/993872/4576c408-a4cb-46fe-a2f2-9cd9c2ed14fa)

Trace Precedents is the core workflow, but SheetWhiz also includes other tools to help you inspect and audit spreadsheets faster.

With Trace Dependents, you can see which formulas rely on the cell you are changing. Before editing an input, assumption, or formula, you can understand what downstream calculations might be affected.

SheetWhiz also helps you visualize spreadsheet structure with auto-coloring. You can color hard-coded values, formulas, and links to other tabs so it is easier to see what is going on in a model at a glance.

For example, you can quickly distinguish hardcoded assumptions from linked cells and formulas, making it easier to review a model for consistency and potential errors.

The goal is to help you catch problems before they spread through the model and become decisions.

## Built for People Who Actually Work in Sheets and Slides

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e2vizHjWNfE>

Auditing is only one part of spreadsheet work. Once you understand the model, you still need to clean it up, format it, present it, and move quickly.

That is why SheetWhiz includes over 100 spreadsheet and presentation shortcuts.

For people coming from Excel, SheetWhiz brings familiar Excel-style shortcuts into Google Sheets, including paste special, insert and delete rows or columns, autofit and set row height and column width, filters, borders, alignment, merge, freeze panes, and more.

For formatting-heavy work, SheetWhiz includes format cycling tools like number cycling, font cycling, fill color cycling, and indentation cycling.

For reporting workflows, SheetWhiz lets you export a selection as an image into Google Slides while preserving the formatting from your sheet. The image links back to the original source, so teammates can trace the screenshot back to where it came from.

SheetWhiz also includes Google Slides shortcuts, so the same speed gains carry into the deck-building process.

AI is useful when you want help thinking through a formula. But sometimes you do not want to type a prompt or wait for a response. You just want to move faster in the spreadsheet.

SheetWhiz gives you both.

## Why We Built It

Before building SheetWhiz, I worked in tech private equity at Silver Lake and later in finance and operations roles. Excel plus plugins were core to how I worked.

Moving into Google Sheets meant losing speed, visibility, and accuracy, especially when auditing formulas.

Google Sheets is great for collaboration, but it has historically lacked the formula tracing, auditing, formatting, and reporting workflows that spreadsheet-heavy teams rely on every day.

Now that AI is generating more spreadsheet work, that gap matters even more.

If AI writes the analysis, the human still needs to audit it.

That is what SheetWhiz is built for.

## Try SheetWhiz

SheetWhiz is free to try from the Chrome Web Store.

Join over 10,000 professionals at companies like Anthropic, DoorDash, Robinhood, Chime, and GitLab, and make your Google Sheets formulas easier to trace, understand, and trust.

# Dimely and SheetWhiz: Fixing Spreadsheet for Finance Teams

SheetWhiz emerged alongside Dimely, our AI connected spreadsheet, as part of the same mission: making the spreadsheet experience better for finance teams. Dimely focuses on automating your billing spreadsheet work, while SheetWhiz focuses on improving the daily tooling inside Google Sheets itself. Please reach out if interested in learning more about SheetWhiz or Dimely.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96407&key=user_uploads/993872/e1ed2019-4e60-48cf-b350-2df943369696)

**TL;DR: If you miss your Excel productivity and want to be faster, more accurate, and produce more digestible models in Google Sheets, try SheetWhiz for free. Over 17,000 professionals at companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, DoorDash, and Robinhood have used SheetWhiz over 8 million times to boost their productivity in Google Sheets.**

Sometimes Google Sheets just doesn’t cut it.

After working for years in private equity and learning Excel like the back of my hand, the transition to startup finance and ops, where I had to use Google Sheets (on a MacBook to boot!), was incredibly painful. SheetWhiz fixes this so you don’t have to go through the pain I went through.

Since launching SheetWhiz, it’s become the go-to spreadsheet tool for finance teams working in Google Sheets. It’s what finance teams at top tech companies use to move faster and with greater accuracy.

Try the SheetWhiz Chrome extension today with a 21-day free trial and a free forever plan. Visit[ www.sheetwhiz.com](http://www.sheetwhiz.com) and click “Get Chrome Extension” to install the tool.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96407&key=user_uploads/993872/728a0634-015c-4c0b-82cf-d12253995391)

## The Problem

3 billion people use Google Workspace each month and hundreds of millions use Google Sheets in their everyday work. Finance teams are increasingly moving work into Google Sheets because it comes free with Google Workspace, and it’s easier to aggregate data and collaborate in Sheets than in Excel.

The problem? Google Sheets lacks proper tooling for finance teams to streamline their work. As this move to Sheets picks up speed, finance teams are often forced to download files into Excel to complete the work, then re-upload them back into Drive to share once complete.

It also doesn’t help that Excel, over the last 40+ years, has built massive market share in finance with a community of finance educators and tooling, while Google Sheets has focused more on the data analyst and lacks many education touch points that would drive adoption by finance teams. It’s especially frustrating for finance teams, many of whom have Excel training, to lose access to the features and functionality they’re used to.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96407&key=user_uploads/993872/4cc48523-66f5-4f44-94f9-e6d11669d2fb)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96407&key=user_uploads/993872/2974b490-9222-489a-badf-0cd2a341788c)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96407&key=user_uploads/993872/006affdb-e543-48e8-920a-f614f741080d)

Missing features include:

* A robust way to trace precedent and dependent cells
* An easy What-If suite with tools like Goal Seek and Data Tables
* Fast formatting tools and shortcuts
* Exporting into other systems while maintaining formatting

Without these workflows, teams move slower, data quality checks take longer, and spreadsheet output hygiene suffers, with key stakeholders having to work harder to digest takeaways.

Before SheetWhiz, I worked in tech private equity at Silver Lake and later in finance and operations roles. Excel plus plugins were core to how I worked. Moving into Google Sheets meant losing speed, visibility, and accuracy. I searched for a fix and couldn’t find anything close. As my cofounder Peter observed my constant complaining, we decided to build the tool I wanted and use every single day.

## Our Solution

Demo video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e2vizHjWNfE&t>

SheetWhiz brings Excel’s most important auditing, scenario analysis, and formatting tools directly into Google Sheets, all triggered by shortcuts you can customize.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96407&key=user_uploads/993872/25d7badc-b113-4750-8dc1-90905824ee17)

### Current capabilities include:

**Audit and accuracy**

* Trace Precedents
* Trace Dependents
* Auto-Color Hardcodes and Links to Other Tabs

**Driver and sensitivity tools**

* Goal Seek
* What-If Data Tables

**Advanced formatting**

* Number Cycle
* Font Cycle
* Fill Color Cycling
* Indentation Cycle (yes, you can indent in Sheets!)

**Excel formatting shortcuts**

* Paste Special (Alt + E + S)
* Insert/Delete Columns and Rows (Ctrl + Shift + Plus/Minus)
* Border shortcuts
* Add/Remove Gridlines (Alt + E + V + G)
* Set or Auto-Fit Column Width and Rows Height
* Add/Remove Filters (Ctrl + Shift + L) and Open Filter Dropdown (Alt + Down Arrow)
* Alignment shortcuts
* Merge shortcuts
* Freeze/Unfreeze shortcuts

**PowerPoint formatting shortcuts**

* Alignment shortcuts
* Text alignment shortcuts
* Distribute shortcuts
* Grouping shortcuts

**Reporting**

* Export selections as clean images for pasting into other programs like Google Slides and Slack

### What finance teams use SheetWhiz for:

* Understand and debug models in seconds
* Build sensitivities
* Maintain cleaner spreadsheets faster
* Avoid formula breakage
* Export reporting visuals for leadership decks

If you work in Google Sheets, we would love for you to try SheetWhiz and share feedback on what to build next.

Try it free for 21 days at[ www.sheetwhiz.com](http://www.sheetwhiz.com) (click “Get Chrome Extension)

launches.title: Dimely 🪙 - AI Agents for B2B SaaS Finance teams
launches.tagline: Save hundreds of hours every month automating manual finance tasks.
launches.body:
**TL;DR: **[**Dimely**](https://dimely.co/)** automates and brings visibility to time-consuming, error-prone finance workflows so teams can stay lean, audit-ready, and fully informed. We integrate seamlessly with your existing tech stack — no rip-and-replace needed — so you start seeing results on Day 1.**

👋 Hi all - we’re [David](https://www.linkedin.com/in/davidnpang/) and [Peter,](https://www.linkedin.com/in/p2sun/) and we’re on a mission to save finance teams countless hours of tedious, manual work. After logging countless hours on billing tasks in our previous roles, we decided to build the AI agents we wish we had. Dimely handles the mundane chores, maintains a proper data trail, and keeps a human-in-the-loop to ensure **100% accuracy** and **audit readiness**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82959&key=user_uploads/993872/06c793df-f448-42bf-b06a-4bdda1bb6ce1)

# **❌ Problem: Billing for B2B SaaS is manual and error-prone**

This is because:

* **Contracts are complex.** Contracts have multiple SKUs, payment schedules, pricing models, and billing metrics
* **Contracts are unstructured.** Terms are often bespoke and written in by sales teams trying to close deals
* **Data lives in different places.** Usage-based pricing models in particular, require matching contract data in your CRM with usage data from your data warehouse that is not always accurate or structured in a way that works well for billing 
* **Finance needs are deprioritized.** Engineering typically prioritizes product building and deprioritizes finance initiatives
* **High finance tech debt.** Billing systems that work early on remain in place for too long because it takes 5+ months to migrate to another system, resulting in a high number of manual workarounds, typically in spreadsheets

# **🏁 Solution: Comprehensive, AI-driven platform to automate and bring visibility to complex finance processes.**

This is where [Dimely](https://dimely.co/) comes in. We take the tasks that take the most time and automate them while keeping you in the loop. Dimely’s primary areas of focus are:

**✅** Converting contracts to invoices

**✅** Reconciling invoices, contracts, entitlements, and payments

**✅** Calculating overages and invoicing customers (via your billing solution)

**✅** Setting up proper revenue recognition

What makes Dimely unique: 

* **High time to value.** We integrate within your existing workflows - no need to rip and replace anything
* **No engineers required.** Set up Dimely through our UI and with natural language
* **Flexible.** We know billing is heterogeneous, and various companies do things differently. Dimely’s AI copilot understands its workflows and won’t break if something unusual comes up

# **🎇 How it Works:**

Here’s a short demo of a fairly simple but time-consuming workflow where Dimely can assist: creating invoices in your billing solution based on signed contracts

<https://youtu.be/KtA8IlxfVTo>

# **📢 Our Ask:**

* Let us know if you know anyone spending significant time with billing. Specifically, Heads of Finance and Controllers at B2B SaaS startups. We’d love to [chat](https://calendly.com/david-pang-calendar/30min)
* Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/company/usedimely) - we have some pretty good content!
